metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 EBS activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AttachVolume", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "CopySnapshot", "Execute", "EBS Snapshot",
    "CopyVolumes", "Execute", "EBS Volume",
    "CreateReplaceRootVolumeTask", "Create", "Replace Root Volume Task",
    "CreateSnapshot", "Create", "EBS Volume Snapshot",
    "CreateSnapshots", "Create", "EBS Volume Snapshot",
    "CreateVolume", "Create", "EBS Volume",
    "DeleteSnapshot", "Delete", "EBS Snapshot",
    "DeleteVolume", "Delete", "EBS Volume",
    "DescribeFastSnapshotRestores", "Read", "EBS Snapshot",
    "DescribeLockedSnapshots", "Read", "EBS Snapshot",
    "DescribeReplaceRootVolumeTasks", "Read", "Replace Root Volume Task",
    "DescribeSnapshotAttribute", "Read", "Snapshot",
    "DescribeSnapshots", "Read", "Snapshot",
    "DescribeSnapshotTierStatus", "Read", "Snapshot",
    "DescribeVolumeAttribute", "Read", "EBS Volume",
    "DescribeVolumes", "Read", "EBS Volume",
    "DescribeVolumesModifications", "Read", "EBS Volume",
    "DescribeVolumeStatus", "Read", "EBS Volume",
    "DetachVolume", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "DisableEbsEncryptionByDefault", "Disable", "EBS Encryption",
    "DisableFastSnapshotRestores", "Disable", "Snapshot",
    "DisableSnapshotBlockPublicAccess", "Disable", "EBS Snapshot",
    "EnableEbsEncryptionByDefault", "Enable", "EBS Encryption",
    "EnableFastSnapshotRestores", "Enable", "Snapshot",
    "EnableSnapshotBlockPublicAccess", "Enable", "Snapshot",
    "EnableVolumeIO", "Enable", "EBS Volume",
    "GetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", "Read", "AWS KMS Key",
    "GetEbsEncryptionByDefault", "Read", "EBS Encryption",
    "GetSnapshotBlockPublicAccessState", "Read", "Snapshot",
    "ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin", "Read", "EBS Snapshot",
    "ListVolumesInRecycleBin", "Read", "EBS Volume",
    "LockSnapshot", "Execute", "EBS Snapshot",
    "ModifyEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", "Set", "EBS KMS Key",
    "ModifySnapshotAttribute", "Set", "EBS Snapshot",
    "ModifySnapshotTier", "Set", "EBS Snapshot",
    "ModifyVolume", "Set", "EBS Volume",
    "ModifyVolumeAttribute", "Set", "EBS Volume",
    "ResetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", "Execute", "EBS KMS Key",
    "ResetSnapshotAttribute", "Execute", "Snapshot",
    "RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin", "Set", "EBS Snapshot",
    "RestoreSnapshotTier", "Set", "EBS Snapshot",
    "RestoreVolumeFromRecycleBin", "Set", "EBS Volume",
    "UnlockSnapshot", "Execute", "EBS Snapshot"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "AttachVolume", ResponseElements.volumeId,
      EventName == "CopySnapshot", ResponseElements.snapshotId,
      EventName == "CopyVolumes", ResponseElements.volumeSet,
      EventName == "CreateReplaceRootVolumeTask", ResponseElements.replaceRootVolumeTask,
      EventName in ("CreateSnapshot", "CreateVolume", "LockSnapshot", "RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin",
        "RestoreSnapshotTier"), ResponseElements,
      EventName == "CreateSnapshots", ResponseElements.snapshotSet,
      EventName == "EnableEbsEncryptionByDefault", ResponseElements.ebsEncryptionByDefault,
      EventName == "ModifyEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", ResponseElements.kmsKeyId,
      EventName == "ModifySnapshotTier", RequestParameters.StorageTier,
      EventName == "ModifyVolume", ResponseElements.volumeModification,
      EventName == "ModifyVolumeAttribute", RequestParameters.AutoEnableIO,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AttachVolume", "DetachVolume"), RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName in ("CopySnapshot", "CreateSnapshot", "LockSnapshot"), ResponseElements.snapshotId,
      EventName == "CopyVolumes", ResponseElements.volumeSet,
      EventName == "CreateReplaceRootVolumeTask",
        ResponseElements.replaceRootVolumeTask.replaceRootVolumeTaskId,
      EventName == "CreateSnapshots", ResponseElements.snapshotSet.snapshotId,
      EventName == "CreateVolume", ResponseElements.volumeId,
      EventName in ("DeleteSnapshot", "DescribeLockedSnapshots", "DescribeSnapshotAttribute",
        "DescribeSnapshots", "ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin", "ModifySnapshotAttribute", "ModifySnapshotTier",
        "ResetSnapshotAttribute", "RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin", "RestoreSnapshotTier", "UnlockSnapshot"),
        RequestParameters.SnapshotId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVolume", "DescribeVolumeAttribute", "DescribeVolumes",
        "DescribeVolumesModifications", "DescribeVolumeStatus", "EnableVolumeIO", "ListVolumesInRecycleBin",
        "ModifyVolumeAttribute", "RestoreVolumeFromRecycleBin"), RequestParameters.VolumeId,
      EventName == "DescribeReplaceRootVolumeTasks", RequestParameters.ReplaceRootVolumeTaskId,
      EventName == "DisableFastSnapshotRestores", RequestParameters.SourceSnapshotId,
      EventName in ("GetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", "ModifyEbsDefaultKmsKeyId", "ResetEbsDefaultKmsKeyId"),
        ResponseElements.kmsKeyId,
      EventName == "ModifyVolume", ResponseElements.volumeModification.volumeId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
